[Check whichever of the following are applicable] - To applicant's knowledge, decedent did not leave a Will - Decedent's Will has been admitted to probate in this Court - A supplemental application for ancillary administration is attached. Attached is a list of the surviving spouse, children, next of kin, and legatees and devisees, known to applicant, which list includes those persons entitled to administer the estate.
